buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Generic Bidder financial standing: The bidder should not be under liquidation, court receivership or similar proceedings, should not be bankrupt. Bidder to upload undertaking to this effect with bid. 3. Generic Bidder shall submit the following documents along with their bid for Vendor Code Creation: a. Copy of PAN Card. b. Copy of GSTIN. c. Copy of Cancelled Cheque.

d. Copy of EFT Mandate duly certified by Bank. 4. Generic Data Sheet of the product(s) offered in the bid, are to be uploaded along with the bid documents. Buyers can match and verify the Data Sheet with the product specifications offered. In case of any unexplained mismatch of technical parameters, the bid is liable for rejection. 5. Service & Support Availability of Service Centres: Bidder/OEM must have a Functional Service Centre in the State of each Consignee's Location in case of carry-in warranty. (Not applicable in case of goods having on-site warranty). If service center is not already there at the time of bidding, successful bidder / OEM shall have to establish one within 30 days of award of contract. Payment shall be released only after submission of documentary evidence of having Functional Service Centre. 6. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 6.1 Scope of supply — The successful bidder shall supply new, unused and defect-free low-speed electri c scooters conforming to the GeM bid specifications, together with batteries, chargers, keys, standard acce ssories and applicable documentation. 6.2 Maximum speed — The maximum design speed shall not exceed 25 km/h. The bidder shall submit m anufacturer documentation supporting the declared maximum speed and relevant operating conditions. 6.3 Statutory compliance — The offered vehicle shall comply with all applicable provisions of the Motor Vehicles Act, Central Motor Vehicles Rules and other requirements as applicable to the offered vehicle cate gory. Where exemption from registration is claimed, the bidder shall submit evidence of the applicable aut horized testing-agency verification/certification. A speed limit alone shall not be treated as proof of exemp tion. 6.4 Battery and charger — The battery shall be suitable for electric-vehicle use and have appropriate el ectrical protection. A compatible charger shall be supplied with each scooter. The bidder shall provide char ging, safety, handling and maintenance instructions. 6.5 Warranty and after-sales service — Warranty periods shall be as specified in the bid. Warranty co verage shall include manufacturing defects in the vehicle, battery, motor, controller, charger and electrical components, subject to clearly stated warranty conditions. The bidder shall provide authorized service-cen tre (within Pune city jurisdiction) details and a warranty-claim procedure. Defective parts covered under w arranty shall be repaired or replaced without additional cost to the buyer. 6.6 Delivery and inspection — Delivery shall be completed within the period specified in the GeM contr act. Vehicles shall be delivered in good condition with all accessories and documents. The consignee shall i nspect the supplies for conformity with the contract. Damaged, defective or materially non-conforming ite ms shall be rectified or replaced in accordance with the contract. 6.7 Documents to be submitted — The bidder shall provide, (a) manufacturer’s brochure and detailed t echnical specifications; (b) battery, motor and charger specifications; (c) warranty certificates; (d) applica ble statutory compliance or testing certificates; (e) user manual and maintenance instructions; (f) service-f acility details; and (g) declarations required under the GeM bid and applicable procurement rules. 6.8 Price and delivery charges — The quoted price shall include the vehicle, battery, charger, standard

accessories, packing, transportation, delivery and other charges specified in the GeM bid. No additional ch arges shall be payable except as expressly permitted by the contract. 6.9 The bidder shall quote the exact make and model of each item offered. The bidder shall upload manuf acturer’s product manual/ datasheet for verification of quoted specifications of the item/equipment. The b uyer reserves the right to verify the technical specifications from the manufacturer’s published documenta tion. 6.10 If the product found damaged while delivering, the buyer will not accept & not responsible for the sa me. 6.11 Warranty: The seller shall provide support at the consignee location during warranty period. Service complaints shall be acknowledged within 48 hrs of notification. 6.12 Equipment requiring repair shall be restored to working condition within reasonable period, preferabl e within 15 working days. If the equipment cannot be repaired within the stipulated period, the seller shall provide an appropriate new replacement/ alternate arrangement where covered by warranty and contract provisions. The transportation charges if any may be paid by the seller. 6.13 Payment term Clause: Payment should be paid as per provision of DPM 2025 and GeM guidelines. No advance payment will be done. Payment will be made in cheque form after acceptance and installation of all items from this unit. 6.14 All other terms and conditions of the bid shall remain the same as per original bid. 6.15 Fall Clause: The tender will be under fall clause as per DPM 2025. 6.16 The seller should upload undertaking certificate for acceptance of ATCs. . 7. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any.
